clips.title: The story
paras: In the Wetlands, Nek'rosh's Head proves the Dragonmaw chieftain has fallen. Captain Stoutfist receives it as proof that the threat to Menethil Harbor has been broken.

The Dragonmaw clan gathers forces and siege weapons across the marshlands, threatening the Alliance port of Menethil Harbor. After the clan's catapults are burned, the port's defense depends on killing Chieftain Nek'rosh. His severed head gives Captain Stoutfist and the Ironforge authorities proof that the warlord's hold over the Wetlands is broken.
